title: Signal Forge: failure-lineage strip with inline replay & payload diff controls
creator: Maya Ortega
description:
Problem: Support engineers and platform SREs need a fast way to understand multi-hop failure lineage across retries, forks, and cache fallbacks without switching contexts. Existing Console traces show individual failed requests but make it difficult to compare payload deltas between retry attempts or to trigger an ad-hoc replay from the same pane.

Goals: 1) Provide a compact, scrollable 'lineage strip' that represents the causal chain of a logical request (original request → retries → fallback model variants → cached responses). 2) Allow inline side-by-side payload diffing for any two nodes in the strip. 3) Expose a lightweight replay control (replay single node or re-run entire chain with toggles for model variant / quantization / routing policy). 4) Surface probable root-cause hints (error taxonomy tags, transient vs deterministic) and link to relevant rollouts or capacity incidents.

Constraints: Must work within current Console layout (left nav + top timeline). Should avoid heavy server-side compute for diffs—use client diffing for up to 3MB payloads, fallback to server diff for larger. Ensure replays are gated by role/permission checks (Dedicated & Private customers may have stricter rules). Must display token/billing impact estimate for replays.

Design deliverables: 1) Figma prototype with interactive lineage strip and diff panel (desktop-first, responsive). 2) Accessibility notes (color contrast for error states, keyboard focus for strip navigation). 3) Design spec for telemetry: what events to fire when users diff or replay (e.g., debug.diff_opened, debug.replay_triggered).

Acceptance criteria: - Designer-signed off Figma prototype and Handoff file present. - Product/Eng alignment on API surface for replay (endpoint signatures, RBAC). - Usability test with 5 engineers showing <30s median time to identify root cause for sample incidents. - Metrics tracked: replay conversion rate, payload-diff opens, time-to-first-insight.
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Ortega: Initial pitch & sketched wireframes attached. Focused on minimal vertical space for lineage strip to allow long chains without pushing payload inspector off-screen.

2025-02-14 Liam Chen: Engineering viability review — backend can stream payloads via existing request-snapshot endpoint; need new query param ?diff=true for server-side heavy diffs. Also flagged RBAC checks for private deployments.
2025-02-15 Priya Menon (PM): Suggested adding 'estimated token cost' next to replay button. Also requested a compact mode for mobile viewing in the Console mobile web.

2025-02-16 Design review: Shifted diff layout from overlay to split-pane to support simultaneous timeline inspection and diffing. Noted potential performance issues when diffing 10+MB payloads — added fallback flow to show summary + download option.

2025-02-17 Engineering feedback (Liam): Prototype API shape approved. Backend team will add a throttling guard and quota check before allowing replays on hosted accounts. Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4127
2025-02-18 QA note (Anya R.): Verified keyboard navigation on Figma prototype; color contrast pass for error-labels. Minor tweak: increase hit target on strip nodes to 44px min.
